name: Empowered Whiplash

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn dashes toward the target enemy with her lashers, dealing increased damage to them upon completion as well as to all enemies within her path.

amount.text: 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 (+ 4% (+ 2.5% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

scaling.text: (+ 4% (+ 2.5% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

mechanics.evidence: Active: Evelynn dashes toward the target enemy with her lashers, dealing increased damage to them upon completion as well as to all enemies within her path.

parts.text: Empowered Whiplash only applies on-hit effects to the primary target.

mechanics.evidence: Empowered Whiplash only applies on-hit effects to the primary target.

notes:
Evelynn will track the target if they change locations.
  - She will dash to the target's previous location if the target moves 2000 or more units away.
  - She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.
There is no time-out period on Empowered Whiplash.
Empowered Whiplash can be blocked but cannot be dodged and/or missed if Evelynn is blinded.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).

name: Ravage

targeting: Ravage is a single-targeted ability with a self-targeted buff component.
flags.spellShield: will block one hit's worth of damage.
flags.onHitEffects: applies on-hit effects but cannot critically strike or affect structures.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn slashes her target twice, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects with each slash. Additionally, she gains bonus attack speed for 3 seconds.

notes: If Ravage's first hit kills its target Evelynn will strike another nearby target with the second one.

If the target dies while Ravage is being cast its sound and its animation will play but neither buff nor damage will be applied and it will not go on cooldown.
  - If Evelynn loses sight of her target between the animation's beginning and its end Ravage will be canceled and will not go on cooldown.

name: Whiplash

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn whips the target enemy with her lashers, dealing magic damage and applying on-hit effects.

amount.text: 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 (+ 3% (+ 1.5% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

scaling.text: (+ 3% (+ 1.5% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health)

mechanics.evidence: Active: Evelynn whips the target enemy with her lashers, dealing magic damage and applying on-hit effects.

parts.text: Evelynn also gains bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

Gaining Demon Shade resets Whiplash's cooldown and empowers its next cast. The damage based on the target's health ratio for both Whiplash and its empowered cast deals a minimum of 25 and is capped at 450 against monsters.

notes: Whiplash can be dodged and blocked but may not miss if Evelynn is blinded.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).

name: Demon Shade

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Evelynn shrouds herself in Demon Shade after not performing actions that break stealth for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends Demon Shade immediately and places it on a 4-second static cooldown, reduced to 1.25 seconds from casting Last Caress. Taking damage from champions or turrets interrupts Demon Shade and places it on a 1.5-second static cooldown.

parts.label: Demon Shade
parts.text: Demon Shade: While below 250 – 590 (based on level) (+ 250% AP) health, Evelynn heals herself for 15 – 150 (based on level) every second. From level 6 onward, Demon Shade also grants camouflage.

mechanics.evidence: Demon Shade: While below 250 – 590 (based on level) (+ 250% AP) health, Evelynn heals herself for 15 – 150 (based on level) every second.
From level 6 onward, Demon Shade also grants camouflage.

values.context: Demon Shade: While below 250 – 590 (based on level) (+ 250% AP) health, Evelynn heals herself for 15 – 150 (based on level) every second.
Demon Shade: While below 250 – 590 (based on level) (+ 250% AP) health, Evelynn heals herself for 15 – 150 (based on level) every second.

notes: Demon Shade is also placed on a 1.5 second cooldown upon respawning.
Demon Shade's cooldown incurs upon starting the attack windup of the basic attack and upon the cast time of the ability.
Demon Shade activates even if Evelynn is Recalling.

Upon Evelynn's transition into the stealth, Demon Shade will interrupt her in-progress cast commands for unit-targeted spells, excluding E and its empowered cast.
  - If Evelynn's last issued order was to cast E, her transition into the stealth will be followed by an automatic command for casting the ability (if no other orders were issued in the meantime).
Whenever Demon Shade activates, a puff of purple smoke will briefly appear around her.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.

name: Shadow Walk

targeting: Shadow Walk is a self-targeted buff.

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Evelynn becomes camouflaged after being out-of-combat for 6 / 5 / 4 / 3 (based on level) seconds, regenerating 2% missing mana every second and ignoring unit collision.

mechanics.evidence: Passive: Evelynn becomes camouflaged after being out-of-combat for 6 / 5 / 4 / 3 (based on level) seconds, regenerating 2% missing mana every second and ignoring unit collision.

values.context: Passive: Evelynn becomes camouflaged after being out-of-combat for 6 / 5 / 4 / 3 (based on level) seconds, regenerating 2% missing mana every second and ignoring unit collision.

parts.text: Entering combat or using an ability ends Shadow Walk, though not being seen by nearby enemy champions.

notes:
Whenever Shadow Walk activates a puff of purple smoke will trigger and a grey circle will appear around Evelynn and then she will start running differently.
  - The circle indicates the range from which enemies will spot her if she gets too close.
    - Whenever Evelynn approaches a visible enemy champion an eye will appear above them (only visible to her) This eye will change colors depending on how close Evelynn is to them.
      - Yellow means she is about to be spotted.
      - Red means she has been.
        - When spotted, an exclamation mark will appear above Evelynn (only visible to her and her allies)
          - She will not be spotted if hiding in brush or if inside fog of war.
          - She will be spotted by an enemy she has no sight of but Shadow Walk's stealth will not break.
          - She will be spotted if she runs into an enemy Control Ward.

The following can break Shadow Walk's stealth:
  - Certain summoner spells (Exhaust, Heal, Ignite, Recall, Smite, Teleport)
  - Evelynn herself capturing a neutral or enemy altar in Twisted Treeline (red eye for neutral and yellow one for enemy but nevertheless she will be seen by enemies)

name: Hate Spike

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn launches a dart in the target direction, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit and marking them for 4 seconds.
Evelynn's next 3 basic attacks on-hit or abilities against the marked target deal bonus magic damage.

mechanics.evidence: Evelynn's next 3 basic attacks on-hit or abilities against the marked target deal bonus magic damage.

parts.text: Hate Spike may be recast up to 3 times at no cost until the ability comes off cooldown.

parts.label: Recast
parts.text: Recast: Evelynn unleashes a line of deadly spikes in the direction of the nearest visible enemy that deals magic damage to all enemies struck.

mechanics.evidence: Recast: Evelynn unleashes a line of deadly spikes in the direction of the nearest visible enemy that deals magic damage to all enemies struck.

parts.text: Hate Spike's recast prioritizes targeting Evelynn's attack target, then the nearest enemy champion, then the nearest non-champion.
A nearby visible enemy is required to recast this ability.

mechanics.evidence: A nearby visible enemy is required to recast this ability.

notes: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse passive.
Hate Spike prioritizes:
# The last champion Evelynn hit
# The last non-champion Evelynn hit
# The lowest-health champion
# The lowest-health non-champion
The dart applies spell damage and the spikes deal area damage.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
Recasts can be buffered up to 0.5 seconds before becoming castable at a maximum range of approximately 500 units.

name: Agony's Embrace

targeting: Agony's Embrace is a ground-targeted area of effect with a self-targeted buff component.
flags.spellShield: will block the damage and prevent the shield from growing in strength.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn impales enemies in target area, dealing magic damage and slowing them for 2 seconds, capped at 1000 against monsters.

amount.text: 15 / 20 / 25% (+ 1% per 100 AP) of target's current health

mechanics.evidence: Active: Evelynn impales enemies in target area, dealing magic damage and slowing them for 2 seconds, capped at 1000 against monsters.

parts.text: Evelynn siphons her victims' pain, shielding herself for up to 6 seconds for every enemy champion hit by Agony's Embrace.

notes: When casting Agony's Embrace the damage will be applied after a brief delay (~0.25 seconds)

name: Last Caress

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn reveals her true form, becoming untargetable at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies struck within. After 0.5 seconds, she blinks 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Evelynn reveals her true form, becoming untargetable at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies struck within.
After 0.5 seconds, she blinks 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again.

parts.text: Last Caress is empowered to deal 240% damage against enemies below 30% of their maximum health.

notes: Last Caress can be buffered during Empowered Whiplash.
The casting input controls the direction Last Caress' damage is dealt from, with the movement automatically happening in the reverse direction.
Enemy champions below the health threshold are marked for Evelynn, indicating the target will receive Last Caress' increased damage.
The screen will direct to Evelynn's position after she blinks.

name: Allure

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn marks the target enemy champion or medium or large monster with a curse for 5 seconds.

Evelynn's next basic attack or ability hit against the target consumes the mark, slowing them by 45% for 0.75 seconds and refunding Allure's mana cost. If the target was marked for at least 2.5 seconds, the consumption is empowered.

mechanics.evidence: Evelynn's next basic attack or ability hit against the target consumes the mark, slowing them by 45% for 0.75 seconds and refunding Allure's mana cost.

parts.label: Empowered Bonus
parts.text:
Empowered Bonus: The target is charmed for a few seconds and the slow duration is increased to the same period. Additional effects are also applied based on the target type:
* Against champions, inflicts a magic resistance reduction for 4 seconds.
* Against monsters, the triggering effect deals bonus magic damage and the duration of the charm is increased by 2.25 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Empowered Bonus: The target is charmed for a few seconds and the slow duration is increased to the same period.
Empowered Bonus: The target is charmed for a few seconds and the slow duration is increased to the same period.
* Against monsters, the triggering effect deals bonus magic damage and the duration of the charm is increased by 2.25 seconds.

parts.text: Casting Allure does not break Demon Shade nor its fade into it.

notes:
The mark fully forming signifies the 2.5 seconds have elapsed, meaning the charm will be applied on the triggering attack or ability.
  - An enemy champion cursed by Allure is alarmed of her presence and after the mark has fully formed, an arrow will appear next to them pointing towards Evelynn's direction. This is visible to both teams.
The magic resistance reduction will be applied to the attack or ability that triggers it.

Allure's mark application on a target cannot be blocked by spell shield.
  - The mark's consumption will not occur if the ability is blocked by a spell shield, causing the mark to remain on the target.

The magic resistance reduction debuff is applied independently of the Charm debuff when the matured mark is expunged, meaning a target can still have their magic resistance reduced while they are resisting applications of CC debuffs (e.g. Black Shield).

If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.
  - Allure will restart its cooldown whenever the mark debuff is removed.

name: Dark Frenzy

targeting: Dark Frenzy is a self-targeted buff.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Evelynn enters a frenzy, removing all slows affecting her. For the next 3 seconds, she gains bonus movement speed and is ghosted.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Evelynn enters a frenzy, removing all slows affecting her.
For the next 3 seconds, she gains bonus movement speed and is ghosted.

parts.text: Dark Frenzy's cooldown is reduced by 1 second every time Evelynn damages an enemy champion with an ability, and its cooldown is refreshed on enemy champion takedowns.

notes: Dark Frenzy has no cast time and does not interrupt Evelynn's previous orders.
